summary: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held at 5:00 p.m. Israel time on December 1, 2026, at the company's Haifa offices. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 contain the Notice and Proxy Statement and the proxy card for proposals No. 1 and No. 2. The board recommends a FOR vote on each proposal. As a foreign private issuer, ZIM is exempt from US proxy rules. No special-situation transaction, pricing, or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine meeting notice.
